item.description:
HyperFrames v0.8.112

Released on 2026-10-02.

Studio now shows where a dragged clip will land as a new track, and saves no longer wait on thumbnails. Nearly thirty CLI, lint and render fixes make checks quieter and more exact.

Features

  • Studio: Export timeline row order and fade handle boxes, readable fx badge (05145bf73, #4904).
  • Studio: Preview timeline track insertion (67dbcf7bd, #4907).
  • Skills: Motion-blur-streak — per-frame-driven form for elements riding a baked track (0a04f80bb, #3781).
  • Studio: Give timeline clips a Filmstrip name band (0b1f5979f, #4897).

Fixes

  • Lint: Fail skill lint on unresolved doc cross-references (e8ff5ca8c, #3922).
  • Lint: Flag static composition hosts without opt-out (9a4b2a2d7, #3763).
  • Skills: Stop mirroring skills into Codex and remove old mirror links (d865b5a7c, #4105).
  • Lint: Flag seek-unsafe CSS transitions (f2eb6d9cc, #3797).
  • CLI: Distinguish a skipped browser check from a genuinely clean one (b31fb02c7, #3901).
  • CLI: Stop lambda deploy from pointing at a nonexistent --sam-template flag (a7e95c0e3, #3879).
  • Studio: A saved clip volume reaches the timeline store (30ed3cd12, #4883).
  • Ci: Skill docs may name the project files a workflow writes (84898fbe8, #4902).
  • CLI: Recapture snapshot composites after video injection (bad0bc7ce, #4767).
  • Engine: Preserve composition root background in alpha exports (d7285e414, #3976).
  • Lint: Dedupe CSS transform text in gsap_css_transform_conflict (50864d57a, #3761).
  • CLI: Reject extra positional arguments passed to add (ded5fa866, #3891).
  • CLI: Recognize textual motion in sweep checks (e8659cb65, #3707).
  • CLI: Keep check --json stdout pure by sending proxy pre-resolve diagnostics to stderr (1a619785d, #3836).
  • CLI: Connector dash gate honours pathLength (5aa3c8f72, #3954).
  • CLI: Refuse capture folders that resolve outside the output root (d2cdad418, #4789).
  • Media Use: Honour HYPERFRAMES_PYTHON in the audio engine (#4614) (f1b79d8e7, #4723).
  • CLI: Capture snapshot --at at the exact requested instant (8aefd91bf, #4827).
  • CLI: Connector_detached now skips fully dash-hidden connector shafts (efdabb758, #3912).
  • Lint: Error on digit-leading ids only when a selector targets them (385e9cf33, #3980).
  • Lint: Point the repeated fromTo baseline hint at immediateRender: false (1248639e7, #3895).
  • Lint: Flag an id override written with reduced-specificity selector forms (9afafa79e, #3871).
  • Engine: Warn when a video input declares alpha but decodes opaque (cad7dbed0, #3771).
  • CLI: Route FFmpeg exec-failure hint through getFFmpegInstallHint() (0eba8d6a0, #3877).
  • Lint: Ignore attribute values when checking media attributes (924b93345, #4396).
  • Producer: Honor FFMPEG_PROCESS_TIMEOUT_MS during video-frame extraction (e0d4c9600, #3918).
  • Unbreak the regression suite on Windows (PSNR filtergraph escaping + console window popups) (9d6ca4585, #3839).
  • Engine: Pin capture surface scale to 1 device pixel per CSS pixel (6632d99c9, #3782).
  • Release: Use portable Git paths in release guards (74e6df437, #3766).

Docs & Examples

  • Skills: Fix unresolved cross-references in skill docs (94650480e, #3951).
  • Align infinite-repeat guidance with bounded repeat: -1 lint (6f799aaa4, #3795).
  • Clarify skills installer behavior (ecfcbb0c6, #3863).

Internal

  • Deps: Update node.js (0b88cd053, #4245).
  • Renovate: Stop raising engines and peer dependency floors (6090f539e, #4900).
  • Deps: Update github-actions (29ded9b0f, #3934).
  • Studio: Score edits on GSAP-animated size, scale, rotation and keyframes (70ed332a4, #4866).

Full changelog

item.title: v0.8.107
item.description:
HyperFrames v0.8.107

Released on 2026-10-02.

Manual editing in Studio is far more reliable: resizes, crops and drops survive undo and reload, and undo works right after an edit or during a drag. Apps that embed Studio can also run its agent tools on their own edit session, and a video's sound now stays on its clip by default.

Features

  • Keep a video's sound on the clip by default (1/8) (37f30b1d06c, #4813).
  • Studio: Hosts can run Studio's agent tools on their own edit session (7a60b97bf8c, #4882).

Fixes

  • Studio: A failed prepared-content write is a failed commit, not saved (396f2fbf808).
  • Studio: Persist honors prepareContent again so audio edits keep their content step (76c4fc7b3cf).
  • Studio: Edits on GSAP-animated layers keep their keyframes and file positions (d4756f597c0, #4869).
  • Studio: Undo right after an edit undoes that edit, even before its save lands (c3b6e55f7eb, #4807).
  • Studio: The timeline scroll gate catches dropped frames in the virtualized view (21a29c2ac74, #4855).
  • Studio: A focused video or audio player keeps its arrow and play keys (a59d93a027a, #4854).
  • Scripts: Count comments after regex literals in the comment ratchet (fd105807c49, #4879).
  • Studio: An undo that lands mid-drag keeps the box under the pointer (83035e08b81, #4853).
  • Studio: A reload requested while a canvas save is in flight loads again once it lands (d05344b3eed, #4874).
  • Studio: A first animation in a sub-composition file runs from inside its template (30c55694cb9, #4806).
  • Core: A composition made only of a set shows it at a seek in the preview (78e849235aa, #4865).
  • A save's temp file no longer reaches Studio as an outside change (c72b735a8c4, #4857).

Internal

  • Studio: Trim comments to the ratchet (2d690968ccb).
  • Studio: Gates read the base the run measured, and drag frames on a quiet runner (d218cec091a, #4872).

HyperFrames v0.8.82

Released on 2026-09-28.

Renders now match the preview more closely in video frames, fonts and shader transitions. Studio plays back and seeks faster, and the CLI can transcribe with Parakeet after an opt-in install.

Features

  • Core: Export findProjects to list the HyperFrames projects on a machine (e738e10267, #4627).
  • CLI: Tag telemetry and feedback with the app that launched the CLI (fa044a89e5, #4632).
  • Studio: Let a host app mount the timeline toolbar, undo buttons, meters and clipboard (bc73c411f0, #4629).
  • CLI: Transcribe with Parakeet on macOS, Linux and Windows after an opt-in install (5cbef29d3a, #4583).
  • Plugins: Ship portable agent bundles and installation guides (0a5e3c7fc4, #4608).

Fixes

  • Studio Server: Remove the history of a project that no longer exists (bee6a8e17d, #4634).
  • Producer: Gif renders survive rgb frames among transparent ones (5383e486bb, #4610).
  • Studio: A resize after a drag writes its keyframe below the timeline it uses (e7a0b6be2c, #4638).
  • Lint: Studio's lint panel and the CLI label a finding by the composition it names (27f1cfd23e, #4618).
  • Studio: Even out levels lifts the right part of a sped-up or slowed clip (ea494b4672, #4636).
  • Run the configured ffmpeg and ffprobe everywhere and say when an upload was not checked (7fedc689b8, #4611).
  • Studio: A host that swaps its multi-clip trim handler gets the new one (ff14263c03, #4630).
  • Studio: Playback keys do nothing while a dialog is open (358c04e2e2, #4623).
  • Lint: Warn when a clip ends past the root composition duration (13bee74960, #4633).
  • Studio: The live clip list carries mute, volume and sound, and refreshes on change (f55c0bbcb4, #4626).
  • Release: Name Release once in a changelog entry's tags (b41ef425cc, #4567).
  • Producer: Renders use the font named in a var() fallback (04d56d06aa, #4619).
  • Shader Transitions: Shader transitions in renders keep scene layout, styles and animations (4094c7be4c, #4615).
  • Studio: Read and write a clip's in-point the way playback does (2ebfcc04a3, #4624).
  • Lint: A missing image, audio or mask file names the composition that references it (7eb00137a2, #4616).
  • CLI: Commands exit right away even when the network or DNS is broken (693c385508, #4604).
  • Layout: Flag text a clipping card cuts off (09ab947e1a, #4577).
  • Studio Server: Background removal writes only where it checked, even through planted links (03e3755aaa, #4540).
  • Producer: Embed the Google font the page linked instead of a wider cut (918e39e785, #4569).
  • Engine: Renders show the video frame the preview shows at each output frame (e8313b2b39, #4596).
  • Studio: Timeline clip pictures fit the clip instead of zooming in (e188dc0a0a, #4582).
  • Studio: Quick saves no longer refuse each other as outside changes (d4801086c4, #4612).
  • Skills: Keep plugin workflows on their installed release (ff6e2103d7, #4607).

Performance

  • Core: Playback housekeeping runs on a timer, and rebinds stop re-sampling silent media (4ed269ad1e, #4595).
  • Studio: A film with no manual edits skips the edit reapply on each seek (e1e2b16e21, #4592).
  • The preview loads and decodes only the images of scenes on screen or due next (078c493448, #4578).
  • Studio: Playback no longer relayouts the timecode and playhead every frame (471e90c057, #4593).

Docs & Examples

  • CLI: Render help says when page-side compositing is actually used (a380036903, #4572).

Internal

  • Producer: Run the late-host pip and dogs-captions fixtures in CI (625b07fe2d, #4625).

Released on 2026-09-26.

  • Core: The picker offers what is drawn under the pointer, not see-through layers over it (473c86248, #4536).
  • Core: An added sub-composition keeps its declared variable defaults when bundled (89fe898cd, #4539).
  • Core: Pick mode keeps its highlight on the hovered element and offers it on click (0b24a0ea8, #4538).
  • Studio Server: A gesture sent without an idle time holds until another key (162de1a6a, #4513).
  • Core: Muting or unmuting an audio group while playing takes effect at once (fb3fdd4f0, #4532).
  • Studio Server: Undo of a studio edit keeps a save that landed just before it (9faade09e, #4524).
  • Studio: An effect save resolves with whether it landed, was refused or failed (5b034cab7, #4531).
  • Core: A film stops at its declared length instead of playing its animation past it (79144f914, #4530).
  • Studio: Playback no longer re-renders the whole app every frame (5a74db903, #4529).
  • Studio Server: Studio element edits keep a save that lands while they apply (0f14691c7, #4510).
  • Shader Transitions: A runtime seek during the prewarm is where the preview lands (0bb7b2f61, #4523).
  • Studio: A copied clip pastes as saved, not with the preview's hidden styles (516320c28, #4506).
  • Shader Transitions: A paused preview keeps the runtime's scene visibility (5fc876673, #4522).
  • Player: End and loop films whose length falls between two frames (5e962a4ee, #4504).
  • Core: A video's voice keeps pace with the playhead instead of trailing it (f2c63ca42, #4511).
  • Studio: A picked element's edit writes only that element to source (b66739820, #4508).
  • Core: Scrubbing stays audible after the first Play (416d009a6, #4517).
  • Core: A project path typed in another letter case stays inside the project (259f65c00, #4514).

Performance

  • Studio: Tag each scene's parts in the preview so one scene can be swapped (dce0acd6d, #4503).
  • Core: A paused preview stops running its audio output (36db44d9b, #4534).
  • Runtime: Swap edited scenes into the running preview from a rebuilt document (cb8e7995a, #4502).
  • Studio: A clip's filmstrip decodes 9 frames instead of 272 and reaches the clip's end (db42e6022, #4526).
  • Studio: Let a paused preview check in once a second instead of every 80 ms (0985b45c3, #4512).

Catalog

  • Registry: Carousel cards fall back to their sample image inside the assets folder (8798e40da, #4543).

Internal

  • Media Use: Tests never write into the person's media library (c238abfe6, #4459).
  • Repo: Keep one fallow audit base cache per checkout instead of one per main commit (81d8a03d2, #4525).
